name: att
query:
WITH RECURSIVE DateRange AS (
    SELECT %(from_date)s AS attendance_date
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE_ADD(attendance_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
    FROM DateRange
    WHERE attendance_date < %(to_date)s
),

-- Fetch all check-in/out records within date range
CheckinRecords AS (
    SELECT 
        ci.employee,
        DATE(ci.time) AS attendance_date,
        ci.time AS checkin_time,
        ci.log_type
    FROM `tabEmployee Checkin` ci
    WHERE DATE(ci.time) BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
      AND (%(employee)s IS NULL OR ci.employee = %(employee)s)
),

-- Pair each IN check-in with the next valid OUT check-in (no other IN between)
PairedINOUT AS (
    SELECT 
        ci.employee,
        ci.attendance_date,
        ci.checkin_time AS in_time,
        MIN(o.checkin_time) AS out_time
    FROM CheckinRecords ci
    LEFT JOIN CheckinRecords o
        ON o.employee = ci.employee
        AND o.log_type = 'OUT'
        AND o.checkin_time > ci.checkin_time
        AND o.checkin_time <= DATE_ADD(ci.checkin_time, INTERVAL 2 DAY)
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM CheckinRecords i2
            WHERE i2.employee = ci.employee
              AND i2.log_type = 'IN'
              AND i2.checkin_time > ci.checkin_time
              AND i2.checkin_time < o.checkin_time
        )
    WHERE ci.log_type = 'IN'
    GROUP BY ci.employee, ci.checkin_time, ci.attendance_date
),

-- Find unpaired OUT entries
UnpairedOUT AS (
    SELECT 
        o.employee,
        o.attendance_date,
        NULL AS in_time,
        o.checkin_time AS out_time
    FROM CheckinRecords o
    WHERE o.log_type = 'OUT'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM PairedINOUT p
          WHERE p.employee = o.employee
            AND p.out_time = o.checkin_time
      )
),

-- Combine paired and unpaired records
CheckinPairs AS (
    SELECT employee, attendance_date, in_time, out_time
    FROM PairedINOUT
    UNION ALL
    SELECT employee, attendance_date, in_time, out_time
    FROM UnpairedOUT
),

-- Generate present records (with working hours calculation)
PresentRecords AS (
    SELECT
        cp.employee,
        emp.employee_name,
        cp.attendance_date,
        DAYNAME(cp.attendance_date) AS attendance_day,
        'Present' AS status,
        cp.in_time,
        cp.out_time,
        ROUND(
            CASE
                WHEN cp.in_time IS NOT NULL AND cp.out_time IS NOT NULL
                THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, cp.in_time, cp.out_time) / 3600.0
                ELSE 0
            END, 3
        ) AS working_hours,
        CASE 
            WHEN cp.in_time IS NOT NULL AND cp.in_time > CONCAT(cp.attendance_date, ' 09:00:00') THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS late_entry
    FROM CheckinPairs cp
    LEFT JOIN `tabEmployee` emp ON cp.employee = emp.employee
    WHERE cp.in_time IS NOT NULL
),

-- Generate absent records (employees with no check-ins)
AbsentRecords AS (
    SELECT
        emp.employee,
        emp.employee_name,
        dr.attendance_date,
        DAYNAME(dr.attendance_date) AS attendance_day,
        'Absent' AS status,
        NULL AS in_time,
        NULL AS out_time,
        0 AS working_hours,
        0 AS late_entry
    FROM DateRange dr
    CROSS JOIN `tabEmployee` emp
    LEFT JOIN CheckinPairs cp
        ON emp.employee = cp.employee
        AND cp.attendance_date = dr.attendance_date
    WHERE (%(employee)s IS NULL OR emp.employee = %(employee)s)
      AND cp.employee IS NULL
    GROUP BY emp.employee, dr.attendance_date
),

-- Combine all records
AllRecords AS (
    SELECT * FROM PresentRecords
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM AbsentRecords
),

-- Add grand total row
GrandTotal AS (
    SELECT 
        'Total' AS employee,
        NULL AS employee_name,
        NULL AS attendance_date,
        NULL AS attendance_day,
        NULL AS status,
        NULL AS in_time,
        NULL AS out_time,
        SUM(working_hours) AS working_hours,
        NULL AS late_entry
    FROM AllRecords
    WHERE (%(employee)s IS NULL OR employee = %(employee)s)
)

-- Final output: exactly 9 columns to match your report config
SELECT 
    employee,
    employee_name,
    attendance_date,
    attendance_day,
    status,
    in_time,
    out_time,
    working_hours,
    late_entry
FROM AllRecords

UNION ALL

SELECT 
    employee,
    employee_name,
    attendance_date,
    attendance_day,
    status,
    in_time,
    out_time,
    working_hours,
    late_entry
FROM GrandTotal

ORDER BY 
    CASE WHEN employee = 'Total' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    attendance_date,
    employee;
